blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在机器人操控中表现出了希望,但单是模仿学习(IL)往往会挣扎去掌握复杂的长视距技能. 强化学习为进一步改进职业劳工政策提供了有效途径。 然而,由于轨迹水平微薄的奖励,现有的VLA-RL方法通常受到延迟和有偏向的信用分配的影响,而不平衡的子任务掌握则造成了瓶颈,限制了总体绩效. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议采用原子核研究(AtomicRL),即利用原子任务结构进行可靠的信用分配和适应性探索的辐射后培训框架。 AttomicRL引入了语义-智能政策优化(SAPO),它使用语义-感知地标来约束因跨越任务界限传播而失败的原子子任务而遗留的TD,减轻信用污染,同时保留子任务内信用分配和价值夹. 此外,Bottleneck-Adaptive Goal Exploration(BATE)在掌握单个原子子任务的基础上,动态地协调任务采样和地方探索激励,将学习引导到剩下的瓶颈. 最后,我们开发了一个Real2Sim2Real管道,在模拟现实世界的部署中连接在线RL,促进实际向物理机器人的转移. 在LIBERO-LONG上,AtomicRL在两个VLA架构上比PPO实现3.6%和4.0%的绝对性能增益. 在CALVIN ABC-D上,它比PPO提高了9.5%的全任务性能. 与Real2Sim2 Real输油管结合,AtomicRL进一步提高了现实世界的任务性能平均21.3%. 这些结果表明,AtomicRL有效地提高了学习效率并改进了VLA政策在长距离任务上的操纵性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) ( Beyer et al., 2024 ; Deitke et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) have established Vision–Language–Action (VLA) ( Intelligence et al., 2025b ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) models as a prominent paradigm for robotic manipulation. Although imitation learning (IL) from large-scale robot demonstrations enables VLA models to acquire diverse manipulation skills, its performance is inherently constrained by the coverage of the demonstration data. Reinforcement learning (RL) overcomes this limitation by directly optimizing policies with task feedback obtained through environment interaction, and recent work ( Li et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) has successfully applied RL to VLA models. However, existing VLA-RL methods still face substantial challenges in long-horizon manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言模型(VLMs)(Beyer等人,2024年;Deitke等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年)的最新进展,建立了远景-语言-行动(VLA)(Intelligence等人,2025b;Kim等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025b)模型,作为机器人操纵的突出范例. 虽然大规模机器人演示的模仿学习(IL)使得VLA模型能够获得不同的操纵技能,但其性能在本质上受到演示数据覆盖的限制. 加强学习(RL)通过直接优化政策,利用通过环境互动获得的任务反馈来克服这一局限性,最近的工作(李等人,2026年;徐等人,2026年)成功地将RL应用于VLA模型. 然而,VLA-RL的现有方法在长期操纵任务中仍然面临重大挑战。

blocks.en:
First, most methods rely on terminal-only success rewards. In an episode that completes the first k k subtasks but fails at subtask k + 1 k+1 , the absence of a terminal success reward causes generalized advantage estimation (GAE) to propagate failure-related temporal-difference (TD) residuals backward to t 0 t_{0} , suppressing the advantages of correctly executed actions. We refer to this as credit contamination, where useful behavior in failed trajectories is systematically devalued, with the effect worsening as the horizon grows.
Prior work ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Zhai et al., 2025 ) mitigates reward sparsity through stage-level preference optimization or subtask-level intermediate rewards, but these approaches alter reward density without resolving credit contamination.
Second, subtask mastery is uneven, with failures increasingly concentrated in a few bottleneck subtasks during later training. Uniform task sampling and fixed exploration then waste interaction budget on saturated subtasks while providing insufficient exploration for the bottlenecks.
blocks.zh:
首先,大多数方法都依赖于终端唯一的成功奖励. 在一集完成第一个 k k 子任务但失败在子任务 k + 1 k+ 1 中, 缺乏终极成功奖励导致普遍优势估计(GAE) 传播与失败相关的时间偏差(TD) 剩余值后退至 t t_{0} 压制正确执行动作的优点. 我们将此称为信用污染,即失败轨迹中的有益行为被系统地贬低价值,其影响随着地平线的扩大而恶化。
以前的工作(Chen等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026a年;Tan等人,2025年;Zhai等人,2025年)通过阶段级优惠优化或次任务级中级奖励,减轻了悬赏性,但这些方法在不解决信用污染的情况下改变奖励密度.
第二,子任务掌握力不均匀,失败越来越多地集中在后来的训练中的一些瓶颈子任务上. 统一任务取样和固定勘探,然后将废物交互预算用于饱和子任务,同时对瓶颈的探索不足。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of AtomicRL. Unlike previous RL methods that use standard GAE which may suffer from credit contamination, AtomicRL uses SAPO to promote more reliable credit assignment. Together with BATE and the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL achieves strong performance on long-horizon manipulation tasks in both simulation and the real world.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, as illustrated in Fig. 1 , an RL post-training framework built around atomic task structure. Our key insight is that semantic subtasks provide a unified basis for both the propagation of learning signals and the allocation of exploration resources. AtomicRL couples Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO) with Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE), supported by a lightweight Progress–Completion Critic (PCC) that estimates atomic subtask progress and completion boundaries. PCC also provides progress estimates for constructing dense progress-based shaping rewards (PBSR).
SAPO modulates TD-residual propagation in advantage estimation with a soft gate conditioned on semantic boundaries. Within each atomic subtask, it preserves standard GAE trace decay; across subtask boundaries, it maintains propagation between successful subtasks while attenuating residuals from failed subtasks. By leaving one-step TD residuals and value bootstrapping unchanged, SAPO reduces failure interference while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and successful subtask dependencies.
BATE tracks the mastery of each subtask via a moving average of its completion rate, jointly adjusts the sampling weight of full tasks and the strength of subtask-level entropy regularization, directing interaction and exploration resources toward bottleneck subtasks.
Finally, to support physical deployment, we develop an automated Real2Sim2Real pipeline. Given a single real-world multimodal demonstration and the required auxiliary information, the pipeline reconstructs an interactive simulation environment. It connects simulation-based RL with real-robot deployment, shifting costly physical trial-and-error to parallel simulation with reproducible resets.
blocks.zh:
为了应付这些挑战,我们建议原子核研究,如图1所示,这是一个围绕原子任务结构建立的辐射后训练框架。 我们的主要见解是,语义子任务为传播学习信号和分配勘探资源提供了统一的基础。 AtomicRL配对 Semantic-Aware Policy Optimation (SAPO) 与 Bottleneck-Adaptive 目标探索(BATE),由轻量级进步–Confletion Critic (PCC) 支持,后者估计原子子任务的进展和完成边界. PCC还提供了构建密集的基于进展的塑造奖励(PBSR)的进展估计.
SAPO以以语义边界为条件的软门来调节TD-剩余传播的优势估计。 在每一个原子子任务中,它保留标准的GAE痕量衰减;跨越子任务边界,在成功子任务之间保持传播,同时减弱失败子任务的剩余部分. SAPO通过不改变单步TD残留和价值约束,减少故障干扰,同时保留子任务内部的信用分配和成功的子任务依赖。
BATE通过移动平均值的完成率跟踪每个子任务的掌握情况,联合调整全部任务的采样权重和子任务一级 en规范化强度,引导互动和勘探资源向瓶颈子任务方向发展.
最后,为了支持实际部署,我们开发了一个自动化的Real2Sim2Real管道. 鉴于一个单一的现实世界多式联运示范和所需的辅助信息,管道重建了一个交互式模拟环境。 它将基于模拟的RL与真机器人部署连接起来,将昂贵的物理试验和误差转换为与可复制的再生设备平行的模拟.

blocks.en:
We conduct extensive experiments in both simulation and the real world. On LIBERO-LONG ( Liu et al., 2023 ) AtomicRL achieves success rates of 99.0% with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025b ) and 98.8% with OpenVLA-OFT ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , improving over PPO by 3.6% and 4.0%. On CALVIN ABC-D ( Mees et al., 2022 ) , the average completed sequence length improves from 3.56 to 4.56, while the success rate of completing full five-subtask chain improves by 9.5% over PPO.
Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further yields an average improvement of 21.3% on real-robot long-horizon tasks. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of AtomicRL for long-horizon VLA reinforcement learning. Overall, our contributions are as follows: • We introduce AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework built around atomic task structure for long-horizon robotic manipulation. • We propose SAPO to mitigate cross-subtask credit interference and BATE to adaptively direct task sampling and exploration toward bottleneck subtasks. • We develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that streamlines simulation construction and RL training for efficient real-robot deployment. • We validate the effectiveness of AtomicRL through extensive experiments conducted in both simulated environments and real-world robots.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Reinforcement Learning for VLA Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 加强志愿军模式的学习

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) optimizes policies through environment interaction and task-level feedback. Recent work has explored both offline and online RL paradigms for VLA policies. Offline RL approaches leverage task feedback to enable continued policy improvement ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . π 0.6 ∗ \pi_{0.6}^{*} ( Intelligence et al., 2025a ) integrates expert demonstrations, autonomous interaction data, and human corrections through advantage-conditioned learning. For scalable online training, VLA-RL ( Lu et al., 2025 ) and SimpleVLA-RL ( Li et al., 2026 ) explore frameworks for continually improving VLA policies through environment interaction, while RL4VLA ( Liu et al., 2026 ) systematically investigates how different RL algorithms affect VLA generalization. Furthermore, Flow Q-Learning ( Park et al., 2025 ) , Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025a ) and π R ​ L \pi_{RL} ( Chen et al., 2026a ) investigate online RL fine-tuning for flow-matching policies, addressing challenges in action likelihood computation and exploration.
blocks.zh: 加强学习(RL)通过环境互动和任务级反馈优化政策. 近期的工作探索了在线和在线的自愿参与行动政策模式。 离线RL方法利用任务反馈,使政策得以继续改进(黄等人,2025年;张等人,2025年b;张等人,2025年a) (Intelligence等人,2025a)通过优势学习,整合专家演示,自主互动数据,以及人类矫正. 对于可扩展在线培训,VLA-RL(Lu等人,2025年)和SimpleVLA-RL(Li等人,2026年)探索通过环境互动不断改进VLA政策的框架,而RL4VLA(Liu等人,2026年)则系统地调查不同的RL算法如何影响VLA的泛化. 此外,Flow Q-Learning(Park等人,2025年),Flow-GRPO(Liu等人,2025年a)和 πR L\pi_{RL}(Chen等人,2026年a)调查在线RL对流量匹配政策的微调,解决行动可能性计算和探索方面的挑战。

blocks.en:
RL for long-horizon manipulation introduces additional challenges due to sparse and delayed task feedback ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2025c ; Dalal et al., 2024 ) . STARE-VLA ( Xu et al., 2025 ) exploits the semantic stage structure of trajectories to perform stage-level preference optimization and reward shaping, while IG-RFT ( Su et al., 2026 ) combines trajectory-level and subtask-level rewards to provide intermediate guidance. However, dense reward shaping provides useful process guidance over long-horizon trajectories, but cannot eliminate the spurious interference caused by later-stage failures.
In contrast, AtomicRL gates the propagation of advantage signals at the semantic boundaries of atomic tasks to prevent cross-task interference from unreliable signals, while allocating the exploration budget to bottleneck atomic tasks to improve the efficiency of long-horizon RL.
blocks.zh:
长视距操纵的RL带来了额外的挑战,因为任务反馈很少和延迟(Chen等人,2026年b;Li等人,2025年c;Dalal等人,2024年)。 STARE-VLA(徐等人,2025年)利用轨迹的语义级结构来进行阶段级偏好优化和奖励塑造,而IG-RFT(苏等人,2026年)则将轨迹级和次任务级奖励结合起来,提供中间指导. 然而,密集的奖励塑造为长视轨迹提供了有用的过程指导,但不能消除后期故障造成的虚假干扰.
相比之下,AtomicRL在原子任务的语义边界上锁定了优势信号的传播,以防止来自不可靠的信号的跨任务干扰,同时将勘探预算用于瓶颈原子任务以提高长视线RL的效率.

blocks.en: 2.2 Online Reinforcement Learning in Real World
blocks.zh: 2.2 现实世界在线强化学习

blocks.en:
Online reinforcement learning for real-world manipulation is constrained by interaction costs and safety risks. To reduce reliance on real-robot trial and error, some research focuses on learning action-conditioned world models and optimizing policies through imagined interactions ( Team et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Jiang et al., 2026a ) . WoVR ( Jiang et al., 2026b ) addresses prediction errors and their accumulation to improve the reliability of model-generated rollouts for VLA reinforcement fine-tuning
, while PlayWorld ( Yin et al., 2026 ) and RISE ( Yang et al., 2026b ) learn world models from autonomous robot interactions and transfers policies trained through model-based reinforcement learning to real hardware.
Although world models can effectively capture short-term dynamics, long-horizon predictions still exhibit visual distortions and action–state inconsistencies. Other studies adopt an explicit Real2Sim2Real method, combining real-scene reconstruction with physics simulation to provide interactive environments for policy optimization ( Li et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . GSWorld ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) integrates Gaussian-on-Mesh assets with physics engines to support visually faithful policy training, while
RialTo ( Torne et al., 2024 ) constructs digital twins of real-world environments and uses reinforcement learning in simulation to improve policy robustness.
However, constructing environments requires coordinating scene reconstruction, physical asset preparation, and control alignment, making it complex and costly to reproduce. AtomicRL introduces an automated Real2Sim2Real pipeline that uses only a single demonstration to reconstruct a real-world manipulation scene as an interactive simulation environment for long-horizon online RL. The trained policies are then transferred to physical robots for evaluation.

互动成本和安全风险制约了为现实世界操控而进行在线强化学习。 为了减少对实际机器人试验和错误的依赖,一些研究侧重于学习符合行动条件的世界模式,并通过想象中的相互作用优化政策(Team等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年a); 张等,2026c; 蒋等, 2026a). WoVR(Jiang等人,2026年b)处理预测错误及其积累,以提高模型生成的用于VLA强化微调的推出的可靠性.

虽然世界模型可以有效捕捉短期动态,但长距离预测仍然显示出视觉扭曲和行动 - 状态不一致. 其他研究采用明显的Real2Sim2Real方法,结合真景重建与物理模拟,为政策优化提供互动环境(李等人,2025b;王等人,2026). 全球社保组织 (Jiang等人,2025年)将高斯安对梅什资产与物理引擎整合,以支持视信政策培训,同时

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , AtomicRL integrates semantic-aware credit assignment and bottleneck-adaptive exploration for long-horizon robotic manipulation. Specifically, SAPO modulates credit propagation across atomic subtasks (Section 3.2 ), while bottleneck-adaptive targeted exploration adjusts full-task trajectory sampling and local exploration incentives (Section 3.3 ). Both components are supported by a Progress–Completion Critic (PCC), which estimates subtask progress and identifies completion boundaries (Section 3.4 ). For real-world tasks, we further introduce a Real2Sim2Real construction workflow to support simulation training and subsequent transfer evaluation (Section 3.5 ).
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,AtomicRL将语义意识信用分配和瓶颈适应性探索结合起来,进行长视距机器人操纵. 具体而言,SAPO调节原子子任务的信用传播(第3.2节),而瓶颈适应性定向勘探则调整全任务轨迹取样和地方勘探奖励(第3.3节)。 这两个部分都得到进步-完成批评(PCC)的支持,它估计了子任务的进展并确定了完成界限(第3.4节)。 对于现实世界的任务,我们进一步引入Real2Sim2 Real建筑工作流程,以支持模拟培训和随后的转移评价(第3.5节)。

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: We consider a language-conditioned partially observable Markov decision process for long-horizon robotic manipulation. At each decision step t t , the robot receives an observation o t o_{t} , which may include third-person images, wrist-camera images, and proprioceptive states, and outputs an action chunk a t = ( a t , 1 , … , a t , H a ) a_{t}=(a_{t,1},\ldots,a_{t,H_{a}}) , where H a H_{a} denotes the chunk length. A long-horizon instruction is decomposed into an ordered sequence of K K atomic subtasks, G = ( g 1 , … , g K ) G=(g_{1},\ldots,g_{K}) . blocks.en: SAPO addresses temporal credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. It leverages semantic boundaries to selectively attenuate the contribution of TD residuals from failed subtasks to the advantage estimates of preceding actions, thereby regulating cross-subtask credit propagation.

blocks.en:
We develop an automated Real2Sim2Real reinforcement learning pipeline that unifies interactive environment construction, policy optimization in simulation, and deployment and evaluation on physical robots. blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study

blocks.en: We conduct policy-learning ablations on LIBERO-LONG using a weaker SFT checkpoint trained with fewer demonstrations than those used in the main evaluations. This few-shot initialization allows us to examine the contribution of each component under a less proficient initial policy.
blocks.zh: 我们利用一个训练有素的SFT检查站,对LIBERO-LONG进行政策学习,其示威比主要评价中使用的要少。 这种少许镜头的初始化使我们能够根据不太熟练的初始政策审查每个组成部分的贡献。

blocks.en: Reward shaping and SAPO. To investigate the effect of reward granularity, we use the PCC module to construct process-level dense rewards and subtask-level rewards, and compare them under both PPO and SAPO. As shown in Tab. 4 (a), denser rewards do not always yield better performance: under SAPO, relatively sparse subtask-level rewards outperform process-level dense rewards. When the policy success rate is low, dense rewards provide stronger exploration guidance and accelerate early learning. As the policy improves, however, their benefits diminish, while persistent auxiliary rewards may dilute the terminal success signal and shift optimization toward local gains. Motivated by this observation, we use linear annealing to gradually reduce the PBSR weight, providing stronger dense-reward guidance early in training and emphasizing the sparse terminal reward later. This balances early exploration with late-stage task alignment.
blocks.zh: 奖励造型和SAPO. 为了调查奖励颗粒性的效果,我们利用PCC模块构建过程级密集奖励和子任务级奖励,并在PPO和SAPO下进行比较. 如附件4(a)所示,较密集的奖励并不总是能产生更好的业绩:在SAPO下,较稀少的次级任务一级的奖励优于进程一级的密集奖励。 当政策成功率低时,密集的奖励可以提供更强有力的探索指导,加快早期学习. 然而,随着政策的改进,它们的好处减少,而持续的辅助奖励可能会削弱最终成功信号,并将优化转向地方收益。 受这一观察的驱使,我们使用线性厌战来逐渐降低PBSR的重量,在早期训练中提供更强的密集奖励指导,并在后来强调很少的终端奖励. 这兼顾了早期探索与晚期任务协调.

blocks.en: Component analysis. Table 4 (b) presents the incremental effects of successively introducing SAPO, annealed PBSR, and BATE. Starting from a PPO success rate of 78.2%, adding SAPO increases the success rate to 87.8% (+9.6 pp); introducing annealed PBSR further improves it to 89.6% (+1.8 pp); and finally incorporating BATE raises it to 91.2% (+1.6 pp), yielding a cumulative improvement of 13.0 percentage points over PPO. SAPO provides the largest performance gain, while annealed reward shaping and bottleneck-adaptive exploration further improve the policy. Combined with the results in Table 4 (a), where SAPO consistently improves performance across different reward settings, these findings suggest that its gains do not simply arise from denser reward feedback. Together, these results support the complementarity of the proposed components and their ability to further unlock the potential of RL for learning long-horizon tasks.

blocks.en: These results show that PCC can estimate subtask progress and completion status with high precision while maintaining low inference latency. As a core component of AtomicRL, PCC converts the semantic task structure in trajectories into progress and boundary information for policy optimization, supporting SAPO in regulating cross-subtask credit propagation and BATE in estimating subtask mastery. Its prediction accuracy and low inference overhead demonstrate that this lightweight design provides a practical perception and evaluation foundation for RL based on atomic task structure.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,PCC可以高精度地估计子任务进度和完成状态,同时保持低推论延迟. 作为AtomicRL的核心组成部分,PCC将轨迹中的语义任务结构转换为进步和边界信息,用于政策优化,支持SAPO规范跨子任务信用传播,支持BATE估算子任务掌握. 它的预测精度和低推论的间接显示,这种轻量级设计为基于原子任务结构的RL提供了实用的感知和评价基础.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce AtomicRL, a VLA RL post-training framework for long-horizon robotic manipulation centered on atomic task structure. To address temporal credit interference and imbalanced atomic subtask mastery, AtomicRL uses PCC to estimate task progress and completion boundaries, SAPO to regulate the cross-boundary propagation of TD residuals based on subtask execution outcomes, and BATE to shift task sampling and local exploration toward insufficiently mastered bottleneck subtasks. We further develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that connects real-task reconstruction, simulation-based RL, and real-robot deployment, enabling policy improvement in simulation environments with fast parallel interactions and reproducible resets. We validate AtomicRL in both simulation and real-world settings, and the results show that it converges faster to a higher performance level, demonstrating its potential for RL-based long-horizon robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了AtomicRL,一个以原子任务结构为中心的长视机器人操纵的VLA RL后训练框架. 为了解决时间信用干扰和不平衡的原子子任务掌握问题,AtomicRL使用PCC来估计任务进度和完成边界,SAPO根据子任务执行结果来规范TD残留的跨界传播,以及BATE将任务取样和地方探索转向未充分掌握瓶颈子任务。 我们进一步开发一个Real2Sim2 Real管道,将实时任务重建、模拟RL和实时机器人部署连接起来,使模拟环境中的政策得以改进,并具有快速的平行互动和可复制的再现。 我们在模拟和现实世界的设置中验证AtomicRL,结果显示它更快地汇合到更高的性能水平,显示出其基于RL的长视距机器人操纵的潜力.

blocks.en: A.1 Future Work and Limitations
blocks.zh: A.1 今后的工作和限制

blocks.en: AtomicRL improves temporal credit assignment across atomic tasks through SAPO and concentrates exploration resources on insufficiently mastered bottleneck subtasks through BATE. Although the experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness in long-horizon robotic manipulation, the current approach still has several limitations.
blocks.zh: AtomicRL通过SAPO改进了跨原子任务的时间信用分配,并通过BATE将勘探资源集中在未充分掌握的瓶颈子任务上. 虽然实验结果显示其在长视机器人操纵中的有效性,但目前的方法仍有若干局限性.

blocks.en: • AtomicRL improves the utilization of interaction data through more effective credit assignment and exploration-resource allocation, but does not fundamentally address the overall efficiency of online RL training. Even with open-source RL frameworks such as RLinf ( Yu et al., 2025 ) and SERL ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , online RL still requires substantial environment interaction and training time, particularly in real-robot settings where interaction and exploration costs remain high. Reducing the interaction required for effective policy learning, improving online RL training efficiency, and lowering the cost of real-robot training therefore remain important directions for future work. • Our experiments primarily focus on long-horizon tabletop manipulation tasks and initialize RL from SFT policies. The effectiveness of AtomicRL on more open and dynamic tasks requiring stronger embodiment generalization remains to be further evaluated. Recent Agentic RL approaches, such as HarnessVLA ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) and AtomBridge ( Pang et al., 2026 ) have shown potential for open-world tasks and embodiment generalization, providing an alternative direction for long-horizon robotic manipulation. A promising direction is to transfer AtomicRL’s use and optimization of atomic task structure to Agentic RL frameworks, enabling robots to dynamically form and adapt atomic task structures in more open environments and potentially improving the generalization and training efficiency of long-horizon manipulation.
blocks.zh: • AtomicRL通过更有效的信用分配和勘探资源分配,改进互动数据的利用,但并没有从根本上解决在线RL培训的总体效率问题。 即使有了RLinf(Yu等人,2025年)和SERL(Luo等人,2025年)等开源RL框架,在线RL仍然需要大量的环境互动和培训时间,特别是在互动和勘探成本仍然很高的实际机器人环境中。 因此,减少有效政策学习所需的互动,提高在线远程培训培训效率,降低实际机器人培训费用,仍然是今后工作的重要方向。 • 支助 我们的实验主要侧重于长视平板电脑操纵任务,并从SFT政策中初始化RL. AtomicRL对于更开放和更具活力的任务,需要更有力地概括,其效力仍有待进一步评价。 近期的代理RL方法,如HarnessVLA(Zhang等人,2026b)和AtomBridge(Pang等人,2026)都显示出了开放世界任务和浮雕泛化的潜力,为长视机器人操纵提供了替代方向. 一个有希望的方向是将原子核解旋的利用和优化原子任务结构转移至代理核解旋框架,使机器人能够在更开放的环境中动态形成和调整原子任务结构,并有可能提高长视距操纵的概括化和训练效率.

blocks.en: A.5 Additional Results
blocks.zh: A.5 其他结果

blocks.en: Detail Results on benchmarks. Fig. 6 and Fig. 7 show the training dynamics and value-function fitting of AtomicRL. On both LIBERO-LONG and CALVIN ABC-D, AtomicRL improves more rapidly during early training and consistently outperforms PPO throughout subsequent training. Meanwhile, the critic explained variance in the later stages of training is higher than PPO by approximately 12% on LIBERO and 5% on CALVIN, indicating that the value function explains a larger fraction of the variance in the training targets. These trends are consistent with the design of SAPO and BATE: SAPO attenuates the cross-boundary propagation of TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks to completed prefixes, improving temporal credit assignment and reducing interference from downstream failures with previously successful behaviors; BATE concentrates sampling and exploration resources on insufficiently mastered bottleneck subtasks. The concurrent improvement in task performance and value-function fitting further supports the effectiveness of atomic-task-structured optimization for long-horizon policy learning.
blocks.zh: 关于基准的详细结果。 图6和图7显示了AtomicRL的培训动态和价值功能配置。 在LIBERO-LONG和CALVIN ABC-D两个方面,AtomicRL在早期培训期间的改进速度更快,并且在整个培训期间的绩效始终高于PPO。 与此同时,评论家解释说,在培训的后期阶段,在LIBERO和CALVIN上的差异分别比PPO高约12%和5%,这表明价值函数解释了培训目标差异的较大比例。 这些趋势符合SAPO和BATE的设计: SAPO将失败的原子子任务对TD残留的跨边界传播到完成前缀,改善时间信用分配,减少下游失败对先前成功行为的干扰; BATE将取样和勘探资源集中在未充分掌握的瓶颈子任务上。 同时改进任务业绩和价值功能,进一步支持原子任务结构优化对长期政策学习的有效性。

blocks.en: Detail Results on real-world robot. As shown in Fig. 8 , when online RL is performed in the Real2Sim-reconstructed environments, AtomicRL exhibits better training performance than PPO across all three real-world tasks. The advantage is particularly pronounced during early training on Bread Placement (BP), which consists of six atomic subtasks: PPO remains around 50% success over the first 40 training steps, whereas AtomicRL reaches 60% at around step 30 and continues to improve thereafter. This gap reflects the difficulty of learning long task chains under sparse feedback and is consistent with the design of AtomicRL, which attenuates cross-boundary credit interference from downstream failures and thereby makes better use of successful prefixes in failed trajectories. AtomicRL also achieves higher late-stage training success rates on Waste Disposal (WD) and Tabletop Clean (TC), indicating that its training advantage is not limited to a single task. Combined with the simulation–real-world performance correlation analysis in Fig. 3 , these training curves provide an indirect reference for the trend of real-world policy improvement.
blocks.zh: 关于现实世界机器人的详细结果. 如图8所示,当在线RL在Real2Sim重建环境中进行时,AtomicRL在所有三个现实世界任务中表现出比PPO更好的培训表现. 这一优势在由六个原子子任务组成的 " 面包安置 " 早期培训中尤为明显:PPO在前40个培训步骤中仍然有约50%的成功率,而AtomicRL则在30步左右达到60%,此后继续改进。 这一差距反映了在微弱反馈下学习长任务链的困难,并且符合AtomicRL的设计,它减轻了下游故障产生的跨界信用干扰,从而在故障轨迹中更好地利用成功的前缀. AtomicRL在废物处理和Tabletop Clean(TC)方面也取得了较高的晚期培训成功率,表明其培训优势不仅限于一项任务。 这些培训曲线与图3中的模拟-现实世界性能相关分析相结合,为现实世界政策改进趋势提供了间接参考。
